description: Assign rigid block thermal surface properties. The value a is assigned to the surface property with name s. Any number of name-value pairs can be specified.

examples.description: Assign a surface property consumed by thermal contact models

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): an assigned value of 1000 read back exactly via rblock.thermal.prop on all six consoles.
